largest transaction for the client in last 6 months with min. transaction amount being BDT 2,000,000

2. Number of transactions exceed 30 in a single day 
Applicable Customer Type: all individual accounts

3. Number of transactions ≥ 30 in 7 calendar days AND total amount ≥ BDT 2,000,000 
Applicable Customer Type: Student, Housewife, Landlord, Self-employed, Retired, Farmer

4. Positive balance in Credit Card

5. Number of transactions in a month is more than 200% of the average number for the client in the last 6
months with min. no. of transactions being 20 in a single day
